'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 James Booker DS Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-41-Coruscant_Chancellor_s_Office-remaster.webp|label=Coruscant: Chancellor's Office (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Booker
* '''Username:''' JAMESPAULBOOKER
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
